context.body: The reign following Solomon loses both covenant fidelity and visible royal splendor.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: During Rehoboam’s reign, Judah multiplies high places and Shishak takes Temple and palace treasures, including Solomon’s gold shields.
observations.label: Kings remembers Solomon’s gold becoming bronze: action

observations.body: Rehoboam replaces the gold shields with bronze and continues amid war with Jeroboam.
observations.label: Kings remembers Solomon’s gold becoming bronze: response

observations.body: gold shields Solomon made · took away all · shields of bronze

payload.posture: Read 1 Kings 14:21–31 as later memory and aftermath evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Kings narrates the loss without the explicit humility and partial-deliverance sequence found in Chronicles.
